label: Bible Study
prompt: So then neither is he that planteth any thing, neither he that watereth; but God that giveth the _____.
verse: So then neither is he that planteth any thing, neither he that watereth; but God that giveth the increase.
note: Paul planted, Apollos watered — but only God makes anything grow.

label: Warm-Up Word
prompt: Therefore they shall come and sing in the height of Zion, and shall flow together to the goodness of the LORD, for wheat, and for wine, and for oil, and for the young of the flock and of the herd: and their soul shall be as a watered garden; and they shall not _____ any more at all.
verse: Therefore they shall come and sing in the height of Zion, and shall flow together to the goodness of the LORD, for wheat, and for wine, and for oil, and for the young of the flock and of the herd: and their soul shall be as a watered garden; and they shall not sorrow any more at all.
note: Returning exiles singing on Zion's heights, souls like a watered garden — and no more sorrow at all.

label: Sunday School
prompt: And he that was dead came forth, bound hand and foot with _____: and his face was bound about with a napkin. Jesus saith unto them, Loose him, and let him go.
verse: And he that was dead came forth, bound hand and foot with graveclothes: and his face was bound about with a napkin. Jesus saith unto them, Loose him, and let him go.
note: Lazarus walked out still wrapped in graveclothes — Jesus' next instruction was simply, 'Loose him, and let him go.'

label: Deep Water
prompt: And the king of Israel said unto Jehoshaphat, There is yet one man, Micaiah the son of Imlah, by whom we may enquire of the LORD: but I _____ him; for he doth not prophesy good concerning me, but evil. And Jehoshaphat said, Let not the king say so.
verse: And the king of Israel said unto Jehoshaphat, There is yet one man, Micaiah the son of Imlah, by whom we may enquire of the LORD: but I hate him; for he doth not prophesy good concerning me, but evil. And Jehoshaphat said, Let not the king say so.
note: Ahab's problem with Micaiah: the prophet only ever told him the truth.

label: Don't Play With Me
prompt: _____ to keep the unity of the Spirit in the bond of peace.
verse: Endeavouring to keep the unity of the Spirit in the bond of peace.
note: 'Endeavouring' — British u and all — to keep the unity of the Spirit. Unity is kept, not manufactured.
